The '''EU LCS 2015 Spring''' Split was the fifth split of the European League of Legends Championship Series, organized by Riot Games. The season took place from January 22 to April 19, 2015, with the regular season hosted in Berlin, Germany, and the Playoffs held in Madrid, Spain. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Best-of-One format, followed by a Single Elimination Best-of-Five Playoff. The top six teams advanced to the Playoffs, while the eight and ninth place were sent to the [[LCS/Europe/2015/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]] and last place is relegated to [[Challenger Series/2015/Summer|Challenger Series]]. The split featured a total prize pool of $100,000 USD, and the winner earned a place at the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2015|2015 Mid-Season Invitational]].

Ahead of the season, several roster and organization changes took place. [[Alliance]] rebranded to [[Elements]], [[Supa Hot Crew]] was acquired by [[Meet Your Makers]], and the newly promoted teams from the [[LCS/Europe/2015/Spring/Expansion|Expansion Tournament]] were [[H2k-Gaming]] and [[Giants Gaming]]. [[Fnatic]] rebuilt their roster with a mix of rookie and Korean imports, while established organizations such as [[Copenhagen Wolves]] and [[Gambit Gaming]] retained their LCS spots through the [[LCS/Europe/2015/Spring/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]], [[Unicorns of Love]] makes their debut after defeating [[Millenium]] in the Promotion Tournament.
